data.one_liner: Create questionnaires and research surveys inspired by iOS ResearchKit.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to build step-by-step questionnaires, instruction flows, and completion screens with rich answer formats. Supports linear or branching navigation rules and exports results to JSON.
use_when: You need to implement medical or research-style questionnaires.
You want a multi-step survey flow with customizable answer formats and navigation rules.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-page form with standard text fields.
You require complex custom form validation engines beyond standard answer formats.
strengths: Rich out-of-the-box answer formats (choice, boolean, date, scale, text, etc.).
Supports linear and navigable branching task flows.
JSON configuration support for dynamic surveys.
weaknesses: Some advanced custom content widgets and answer formats are still works in progress.
Early stable version with breaking changes in recent history.
data.setup_notes: Pure Dart package; simply add to pubspec.yaml and import survey_kit.dart.
